_about: Who is bound to lore facts, by trade (docs/lore/README.md; decision 376). An official speaks only lore facts; a free one may embellish and lie, in character; anyone unlisted is townsfolk, who do not make things up but keep what they hear. Ids are economy's trade ids (levels/economy.json, items.json made.by), or a role with no job yet. A listed role says how such a person speaks, not that one exists. Read by Lore.binding.
